couplets.en: Once, at least, I felt the loss.

lines: Dil ka ye haal kahaan tha pehle
couplets.en: When had my heart ever been like this?
Once, at least, I felt the loss.

lines: Ab to jhonke se laraz uthta hoon
couplets.en: Now even a passing gust makes me tremble.
Once, I was drunk on deep sleep.

lines: Yoon na ghabraye hue phirte the
couplets.en: I never used to wander in such disquiet.
Once, my heart was a quiet refuge.

lines: Ab bhi tu paas nahin hai lekin
couplets.en: Even now, you are far from me.

lines: Ab bhi tu paas nahin hai lekin
couplets.en: Even now, you are far from me.

lines: Is qadar door kahaan tha pehle
couplets.en: When had you ever been this far away?

lines: Gham ne phir dil ko jagaya, Nasir
couplets.en: Grief has woken the heart again, Nasir.

lines: Gham ne phir dil ko jagaya, Nasir
couplets.en: Grief has woken the heart again, Nasir.
Where had this ruined heart been till now?
